999008199.text:
この島に着いてから、私たちはホルハーツの
有力者の方々に物資の協力をお願いしに行ったんだ

localizations.en: After arriving on the island, we went to see some of the influential figures in Holhartz to ask for their support with supplies.
Resna

999008199.text:
でも、異国の人間がこの島と深く関わるなら、
大きな愛を見せてほしいって言われちゃって……

localizations.en: But they said that if we wanted to get deeply involved with the island as outsiders, we'd have to prove we had a great love to show...
Resna

999008199.text:
ロマンさんが王国名物を贈呈したらしいんだけど、
そういう問題じゃないって一喝されちゃったみたい

localizations.en: Apparently Roman tried presenting them with some famous goods from the kingdom, but they weren't having any of it.
Alvina

999008199.text:
結局、愛を認めてもらうには、もうすぐ開催される
「愛のレース」で優勝するしかないみたいなんだ

localizations.en: So in the end, the only way to earn their recognition is to win a festival they're holding soon—the Love Race.
Resna

999008199.text:
ここまで独自の価値観の島だとは思わなかったなぁ。
文化の違いってすごいよね……

localizations.en: I didn't realize this island had such a unique set of values. Cultural differences are something else, aren't they...
Alvina

999008199.text:
ふふ、なかなか面白い島じゃない。
「愛のレース」って、どんな内容なの？

localizations.en: Heh, sounds like quite the interesting island. So what exactly is this Love Race?
Valeria

999008199.text:
それが……ホルハーツ鳥っていう、
この島固有の鳥のメスを探し出すレースみたい

localizations.en: Well... it's apparently a race to find a female Holhartz Bird—a species native to this island.
Resna

999008199.text:
ホルハーツ鳥は、諸島で絶滅危惧種に
指定されてる鳥なんすよ

localizations.en: The Holhartz Bird is actually listed as an endangered species throughout the Archipelago Federation.
Alvina

999008199.text:
今はオスの個体しか保護されていないみたいで。
でも最近、島の湿地でメスの目撃情報があったんだって

localizations.en: Right now, only male birds are under protection. But recently, there have been sightings of a female in the island's wetlands.
Resna

999008199.text:
そのメスを保護できれば、ホルハーツ鳥の繁殖を
手助けできて、島の人たちも大喜びってわけ

localizations.en: If someone can locate and protect the female, it would help the Holhartz Birds breed again—which would make the islanders absolutely thrilled.
Alvina

999008199.text:
だから報奨金を出して、
レース形式で盛り上げてるんすよね

localizations.en: So they're offering a reward and turning it into a race to make the whole thing more exciting.
Alvina

999008199.text:
なるほどな。ホルハーツ鳥の愛を手助けすることが
大きな愛を見せることに繋がるってわけか？

localizations.en: I see. So helping the Holhartz Birds find love is the island's idea of showing a great love yourself, huh?
Lanze

999008199.text:
優勝しないと協力してもらえないんでしょ？　
だったら、参加しない理由はないわね

localizations.en: And we don't get their help unless we win, right? Then there's no reason not to enter.
Valeria

999008199.text:
はい！　フロッケも頑張ります。
みんなで力を合わせれば、きっと見つけられますよ

localizations.en: Yes! Flocke will do her very best too. With all of us working together, I'm sure we can find it!
Flocke

999008199.text:
天使ちゃん、ケガだけはすんなよ。
俺も全力でやるからな

localizations.en: Just don't go getting yourself hurt out there, little angel. I'll be giving it everything I've got too.
Lanze

999008199.text:
それじゃ、運営本部に向かいましょ。
受付で詳しい取り決めも聞けるはずよ

localizations.en: Then let's head to the race headquarters. We should be able to get all the details at the registration desk.
Valeria

999008199.text:
案内はアタシに任せて！
受付の場所はもうバッチリ把握してるから

localizations.en: Leave the guiding to me! I've already got the location of the registration all figured out.
Alvina

999008199.text: みんなで無事に参加できますように……

localizations.en: Here's hoping we all make it in safely...
Flocke

999008199.text:
みんな、ありがとう。
よろしくお願いします！

localizations.en: Thank you, everyone. I'm counting on all of you!
Resna

999008199.text: 愛の島で一番大きな愛ってやつを見せてやるわよ！

localizations.en: Let's show this island what the greatest love around really looks like!
Valeria
